CODE
2.3.8. 
Modification during the marriage
The spouses may, during the marriage, make any modifications to their matrimonial property regime that they deem appropriate and even change it entirely.
 A prior inventory of all the movable and immovable property and debts of the spouses is required when the modification of the matrimonial property regime entails the liquidation of the pre-existing regime.
 This inventory is recorded by notarial act.
 If the modification of the matrimonial property regime does not entail the liquidation of the pre-existing regime, the deed modifying the matrimonial property regime is preceded by an inventory if one of the spouses so requests.
 In this case, the inventory may be made on the basis of declarations, provided both spouses consent.
